TOLZAR_AGENTS_UI.TITLE: AI Agents
TOLZAR_AGENTS_UI.LEAD: Handle more conversations with less effort: your AI team.
TOLZAR_AGENTS_UI.CREATE_CARD_HINT: Add a new AI Agent to your team.
TOLZAR_AGENTS_UI.DEFAULT_LINE: Default agent: {name}. Tolzar drafts with this agent unless a team has its own (Settings → Agents per team).
TOLZAR_AGENTS_UI.ACTIVE_HINT: Active: the brain may use this agent when it drafts.
TOLZAR_AGENTS_UI.DEFAULT_HINT: Default: used when no team mapping applies.
TOLZAR_AGENTS_UI.INSTRUCTIONS_HINT: Describe the agent's role, communication style and the skills it should perform. Use clear, step-by-step language.
TOLZAR_AGENTS_UI.DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: One line shown on the agent card
TOLZAR_AGENTS_UI.KNOWLEDGE_HINT: Documents, FAQs and links the agent can use to answer.
TOLZAR_AGENTS_UI.DOC_INDEXED: Read {name}: {total} passages indexed. The agent answers from it now (in Shadow).
TOLZAR_AGENTS_UI.LABEL: Label
TOLZAR_AGENTS_UI.PRICES_OFF: Switch on "{switch}" above to set a price source, upload a price table or save a feed key.
TOLZAR_AGENTS_UI.TEST_NOTE: Replies come from your self-hosted model using this agent's instructions, knowledge and prices (saved ones; instructions as typed). This does not touch any real conversation.
TOLZAR_AGENTS_UI.TEST_EMPTY: Send a message to see how your agent replies.
TOLZAR_AGENTS_UI.NETWORK_ERROR: The model did not answer (network error). Try again.
TOLZAR_AGENTS_UI.DELETE_BODY: "{name}" is removed for everyone in this workspace. This cannot be undone.

TOLZAR_WORKFLOWS_UI.DUPLICATE_HINT: Opens a copy of this workflow in the builder. It is saved only when you press Save.
TOLZAR_WORKFLOWS_UI.RUN_IN_SHADOW_HINT: On: new contacts enter this workflow and every send becomes a private 'would send' note. Off: nothing runs.
TOLZAR_WORKFLOWS_UI.VALUE_PLACEHOLDER: The value that starts the workflow
TOLZAR_WORKFLOWS_UI.NO_TEAMS: No teams yet. Create one under Settings → Teams.
TOLZAR_WORKFLOWS_UI.NO_LANGS_HINT: Add languages under Settings → Workspace to write this message in more than one language.
TOLZAR_WORKFLOWS_UI.NO_TEXT_LANG: This message has no language yet. Add one above.
TOLZAR_WORKFLOWS_UI.SETTING_NAME_HINT: Letters, digits and underscores; used as {'{'}name{'}'} in messages.

TEST.OR_CONVERSATION: Or paste a conversation id from its URL (…/conversations/123).

TOLZAR_WORKFLOWS_UI.DELETE_BODY: "{name}" stops and its waiting runs are cancelled. This cannot be undone.
